name: 張文中
objective: Robotics Lab (RLab) is offered with all experimental in-class projects, same as its previous version “Robotics and Automation Applications (RAA)”.  Compared with Robotics course, this Robotics Lab (RLab) course is https://aps.ntut.edu.tw/course/tw/Select.jsp?format=-1 & code = 366205 offered for undergraduate students with programming experience, but no particular prerequisites, such as Robotics, are required.  RLab focuses on projects in the areas of optical inspection, mobile robots, manipulators, visual servoing, and automation expanding the application of AI approaches.  本課程為全實驗課程，等同於原先「機器人與自動化應用」之新版課程。相較於「機器人學」基礎分析課程，機器人學實習 (RLab) 屬應用課程、適合具備基礎程式能力的大學生修習，並無機器人學等先修課程要求。課程專題聚焦於光學檢測、移動式機器人、機械手臂、視覺伺服與自動化並擴展運用人工智慧方法。

延伸教學與資源: ● 混成學習 (Blended Learning) 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
